announcements.title: Países, nacionalidades y lenguas
announcements.message:
Esta semana estamos estudiando los diferentes países, las nacionalidades y los idiomas que se hablan en ellos.

This week we are learning about countries, nationalities, and the languages spoken around the world.

announcements.title: Research your assigned country and a celebrity
announcements.message:
You will be assigned a country. Research its name, nationality, and the languages spoken there. Choose a celebrity from that country and collect information to introduce them.

Write your notes about the celebrity IN SPANISH in your notebook.

announcements.title: Design your country and celebrity poster
announcements.message:
Use the information you researched to create your poster. Include the country, nationality, languages, and information about your chosen celebrity.

You will use this poster in class NEXT WEEK.
